d: Two sides, one known as the Alphas and the other the Rebels, struggle in a brutal war on Earth and in outer space. Starring Paul Mercurio and Michael York.
Based on a true story, this provocative film follows the struggling romance between a terminal young man running out of time and a woman desperate to breathe life into his final days.

An upstate South Carolina family seek the help of two paranormal investigators, Connor Biddle and India Hopwood, to capture evidence of the strange phenomena taking place inside their historical home.
A Place to Live follows the journey of seven LGBTQ seniors as they attempt to secure an apartment in Triangle Square, the nation's first affordable housing facility for LGBTQ seniors in Los Angeles.

Six individuals are caught up in a supernatural perfect storm, as an evil lays claim to one of them while threatening to tear apart the soul of a small Pennsylvania town. Starring Corey Feldman, Brian Anthony Wilson and Nicole Cinaglia.
Six kids take a trip to the Grand Canyon, but their flight detours into an alternate dimension, and only through growing past distrust will they be able to get back home.
In his quest to become the world's greatest air-drummer, a small-town dreamer must overcome obstacles and ridicule to save the day. Starring Ari Gold, Michael McKean, Jane Lynch.

On her wedding night, Jade wakes up holding the hand of her dead husband after she narrowly survived a murder attempt by the criminal family she fled from only weeks before. After pawning her wedding ring for a 357 Magnum she goes after the criminals who ruined her life. Starring Fred Williamson, William Katt, Laurie Love.

In a last ditch effort to save their marriage, Nick and Willa visit a renowned, yet eccentric, couples therapist and embark on a month-long journey of provocative and hilarious sex assignments.  Starring Dan Fogler, Johnny Giacalone, Mandy Kaplan.
Four friends deal with their love lives and learn about themselves while working in a funky sandwich shop in Santa Cruz, California. Starring Elisabeth Harnois, Clea DuVall, Alice Krige.

Beatriz, a failed psychologist, flees to her childhood home to escape fraud charges, only to discover that her quirky aunt has turned the estate into a high school. What seems at first a terrible surprise will in fact help her finally find a fulfilling path in life as an unconventional theater instructor.
When his self-imposed exile from society is interrupted by a group of friends on a hiking trip, a murderous hermit terrorizes the visitors.  Starring Mario Lopez, Gary Busey, Bo Hopkins.

Dr. Davide studies alien abductions. Through hypnosis of the abductees, he has learned that several alien races have been installing, for millennia, their active memories in people's brains, to exploit a special energy: the Soul.
